# Big Red Electric Company

> Big Red Electric Company is a Electrician serving Las Vegas, Nevada. Big Red Electric Company is a family-owned electrical contractor serving Las Vegas, Henderson and the surrounding Clark County area. Led by owner AJ, a union-trained electrician with more than 10 years of experience, the company handles residential and commercial electrical work.

## Contact
- Phone: +1702-875-1066
- Address: 6860 Bermuda Rd #200, Las Vegas, NV 89119
- Website: https://www.bigredelectriccompany.com/
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=5379443910340739399

- Electrician
- Electric vehicle charging station contractor
- Electrical installation service
- Lighting contractor
